name: standardsforge
description: Answer defense engineering standards questions using an existing local StandardsForge MCP connection.

interface.shortDescription: Ask standards questions with exact source evidence
interface.longDescription: Search installed defense engineering standards, retrieve exact edition-bound evidence, and preserve governing conditions and review limits. Requires an operator-configured local StandardsForge MCP connection and installed corpus. This plugin supplies the question-answering skill; it does not install a runtime, download standards or grant access.
defaultPrompt: Use StandardsForge to answer my standards question with exact editions, source pages and governing conditions.
